verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents a first-party Zapier integration that can "connect your mail to 5000+ apps", plus a developer API. That implies event-driven automation from mail activity. However, nothing states that Zapier triggers fire specifically on new mail arrival or scan completion, and no registrable webhooks are documented. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration for outbound HTTP callbacks, explicit Zapier trigger list (new mail / scan completed), payload and event docs, hands-on or independent corroboration.
